message.content: {"hts_code": "8542.90.6000", "reason": "This product is an electronic joystick controller specifically designed for use with various lift trucks. It consists of an injection-molded joystick grip with switches, an electronic control printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), a Hall effect position sensor, and an electrical connector. When in use, the assembly is installed in the lift truck via a wired connection. predicted_reason: This product is an electronic joystick controller specifically designed for use with various lift trucks. It consists of an injection-molded joystick grip with switches, an electronic control printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), a Hall effect position sensor, and an electrical connector. When in use, the assembly is installed in the lift truck via a wired connection. As the user moves the joystick, the sensor and control board send electrical signals that control various functions of the lift truck, including directional guidance, lift mechanism movement, audiovisual signaling, among others.
